caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of brown with darker and lighter areas indicating shading and highlights, suggesting a rounded, three-dimensional form. It has a wide body that tapers at the neck with two horizontal ridges near the top. The mouth of the pitcher is broad and flares slightly outward with a small spout on one side. There is a single, curved handle attached to the upper portion of the pitcher, also shaded in brown. The top opening and the interior rim of the pitcher are depicted with dark brown and faint greenish-yellow accents, giving an impression of depth. There are no additional objects or embellishments in the composition.
title: Pottery Jug
